title: Polish assistant-ui streaming UX
description:
Polish the assistant streaming UX: typing indicator, pinned autoscroll, and retry on error.

## Current Status

- **Desktop:** autoscroll fixed
- **Mobile Safari:** composer still jumps
- **Network retry:** design approved, implementation pending

## Repro

1. Open a long ticket thread.
2. Ask AI a question that streams for 5+ seconds.
3. Scroll during the response.
4. Toggle the iOS keyboard.

## Expected vs Actual

| Area | Expected | Actual |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Autoscroll | Sticks while streaming | Fixed on desktop |
| Composer | Never jumps | Jumps on iOS Safari |
| Retry | Exponential backoff | Not implemented |

## Related

See **BUG-108** before changing viewport logic.

discussions.text: Retry works on desktop, still flaky on subway wifi. Can we replay from the last event id?
Switched streaming to line-buffered events; retry resumes from the last event id. Open: mobile composer viewport jump on iOS — visualViewport handler pending.
